title: Split code_tutor/_analyzer.py under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring python_pkg/code_tutor/_analyzer.py (388 lines) under the repo-wide 250-line cap by moving the file-walking and import-graph half into _deps.py and the static scan tables into _scan_tables.py.
acceptance_criteria: _analyzer.py, _deps.py and _scan_tables.py are each at most 250 lines.
The code_tutor suite still reports exactly 216 passing tests -- the same count as before the split, proving no test was dropped or silently skipped.
The package keeps 100% branch coverage of the code_tutor source modules.
_is_binary, the only name any test patches on _analyzer, stays defined there so that patch string needs no edit.
Every importer of the moved functions -- cli.py, _plan_builder.py and test_analyzer.py -- names _deps directly rather than reaching them through an _analyzer re-export.
No assertion is changed and no test is deleted, skipped or weakened.
No suppression is added and no coverage exclusion is introduced.
out_of_scope: Changing what any test asserts, or which paths the analyzer skips.
Splitting cli.py, _verifier.py, _llm.py or the code_tutor test modules, which are separate commits.
verifier: timeout 90 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/code_tutor/tests -q (expects exactly 216 passed), plus an import-time assertion that every patched name resolves, plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files.
